title: Inverse Problems for the Monge-Ampère Equation: Linearization and Nonlinear Recovery
summary: We study inverse boundary value problems for the fully nonlinear Monge-Ampère equation $ \det D^2u=a(x,u,\nabla u) $ in a bounded domain. Motivated by Calderón-type problems, we introduce nonlinear Cauchy data and investigate the recovery of $a$ from boundary measurements. Around a strictly convex background solution, under a sign condition ensuring invertibility of the linearized Dirichlet problem, we establish local well-posedness and differentiable dependence on boundary data.
